text_ja: 第二条第一号の算式において、普通株式等Tier1資本に係る調整項目の額は、次に掲げる額の合計額とする。一次に掲げる額の合計額イ次に掲げる無形固定資産の額の合計額(１)無形固定資産(のれんに係るものに限り、のれん相当差額(他の金融機関等(第八条第六項第一号に規定する他の金融機関等をいう。)であって、連結子会社(連結財務諸表規則第二条第四号に規定する連結子会社をいう。以下この(1)において同じ。)である保険子会社等又は持分法(同条第八号に規定する持分法をいう。以下この(1)及び第九条第一項において同じ。)が適用される者に係る差額(連結子会社である保険子会社等にあっては連結財務諸表規則第二十八条第五項の規定によりのれんに含めて表示される差額をいい、持分法が適用される者にあってはこれに相当するものをいう。)をいう。第十条第二項第六号において同じ。)を含む。)の額(２)無形固定資産(のれん及びモーゲージ・サービシング・ライツに係るものを除く。)の額ロ繰延税金資産(一時差異に係るものを除く。)の額ハ繰延ヘッジ損益(連結財務諸表規則第四十三条の二第一項第二号に規定する繰延ヘッジ損益をいい、ヘッジ対象に係る時価評価差額が前項第二号のその他の包括利益累計額の項目として計上されている場合におけるヘッジ手段に係る損益又は時価評価差額を除く。)の額ニ内部格付手法採用最終指定親会社において、事業法人等向けエクスポージャー及びリテール向けエクスポージャーの期待損失額(第百二十六条に規定する期待損失額をいう。以下この章において同じ。)の合計額が適格引当金の合計額を上回る場合における当該期待損失額の合計額から当該適格引当金の合計額を控除した額ホ証券化取引に伴い増加した自己資本に相当する額ヘ負債の時価評価(最終指定親会社又は連結子法人等の信用リスクの変動に基づくものに限る。)により生じた時価評価差額であって自己資本に算入される額ト退職給付に係る資産の額二自己保有普通株式の額三意図的に保有している他の金融機関等の普通株式の額四少数出資金融機関等の普通株式の額五特定項目に係る十パーセント基準超過額六特定項目に係る十五パーセント基準超過額七その他Tier1資本不足額
text_en: In the formula of Article 2, item (i), the amount of adjustment items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital shall be the sum of the following amounts. (i) The sum of the following amounts: (a) The total amount of the following intangible fixed assets: (1) The amount of intangible fixed assets (limited to those relating to goodwill, including goodwill equivalent differences (meaning differences relating to entities that are other financial institutions, etc. (meaning other financial institutions, etc. as provided in Article 8, paragraph (6), item (i)) and that are either insurance subsidiary companies, etc. that are consolidated subsidiaries (meaning consolidated subsidiaries as provided in Article 2, item (iv) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation; the same applies in this (1)) or persons to which the equity method (meaning the equity method as provided in item (viii) of the same Article; the same applies in this (1) and Article 9, paragraph (1)) applies — in the case of insurance subsidiary companies, etc. that are consolidated subsidiaries, amounts displayed included in goodwill pursuant to Article 28, paragraph (5) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation, and in the case of persons to which the equity method applies, amounts equivalent thereto; the same applies in Article 10, paragraph (2), item (vi))). (2) The amount of intangible fixed assets (excluding those relating to goodwill and mortgage servicing rights). (b) The amount of deferred tax assets (excluding those relating to temporary differences). (c) The amount of deferred hedge gains and losses (meaning deferred hedge gains and losses as provided in Article 43-2, paragraph (1), item (ii) of the Consolidated Financial Statement Regulation, excluding gains and losses or fair value differences relating to hedging instruments where the fair value difference attributable to the hedged item is recognized as an item of accumulated other comprehensive income under paragraph (1), item (ii) of the preceding paragraph). (d) In the case of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach, the amount obtained by deducting the total amount of eligible allowances from the total amount of expected loss amounts (meaning expected loss amounts as provided in Article 126; the same applies in this Chapter) relating to exposures to corporates, etc. and retail exposures, where such total exceeds the total eligible allowances. (e) The amount equivalent to increases in equity capital accompanying securitization transactions. (f) The amount of fair value differences arising from fair value measurement of liabilities (limited to those based on changes in the credit risk of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company or consolidated subsidiary legal entities) that are recognized as equity capital. (g) The amount of assets relating to retirement benefits. (ii) The amount of self-held common shares. (iii) The amount of common shares of other financial institutions, etc. held intentionally. (iv) The amount of common shares of minority-invested financial institutions, etc. (v) The amount exceeding the 10% threshold relating to specific items. (vi) The amount exceeding the 15% threshold relating to specific items. (vii) The amount of Additional Tier 1 Capital shortfall.
